hypothesis: A fixed cross-asset M1 condition may support net-profitable BTC-only shorts after L5 execution costs, stops, time exits and funding. Neither directional edge nor benefit over existing M1 is established.

identity.history_role: Qualified L5 history is diagnostic reuse for execution only; no forward performance inherited

signal.name: M1_FIXED_EXTERNAL_BREADTH_BTC_SHORT_ONLY
signal.negative_definition: return strictly below zero; BTC included in the fixed denominator
signal.decision_cutoff: For every grid timestamp u use only quotes with received_at<=u and exchange_timestamp<=received_at. Price age measured at u; all 18 symbols present at every required row. No backfill, forward fill beyond 120s, or future API publication.
signal.book_role: Freshness, liquidity and price for simulation only; no L5 directional filter or parameter reselection

timing.admission: First M1 slot when FLAT and cooldown elapsed consumes the UTC-day opportunity before entry/risk/book veto; vetoed or missed opportunity is retained, never replaced that day. Quota persistence precedes scheduling.
timing.entry_deadline: Persist decision within slot+30s, intent before the entry slot; first fresh book received at/after slot+300s+500ms and durably captured by due+1000ms. Missing deadline is MISSED, no historical replay.
timing.entry_revalidation: At arrival validate current equity, risk, freshness and full depth; no new directional test. Reduce frozen intended quantity only to respect caps; never increase or chase.
timing.missed_cooldown: From scheduled entry time for a missed/vetoed attempt; from actual flat time after any opened position.
timing.signal_during_position: Record but suppress; no stacking, no additional entry, no long reentry.
timing.end_of_horizon: Admit only if slot+300s+0.5s+1s+21600s+0.5s+1s <= T1 (latest modeled entry and exit allowance). Existing protective exits remain enabled after T1 and late unresolved exposure is retained in evaluation.

sizing.equity_definition: Cash plus BTC price PnL at a fresh causal mid, minus fees and settled signed funding under this model; unresolved funding or stale mark makes equity provisional and blocks new risk.
sizing.rounding: Decimal arithmetic, floor quantity toward zero. Below step or synthetic minimum means NO_TRADE. No quantity bump to satisfy a minimum.
sizing.depth: Require complete displayed L5 size for entry; consume native size q_BTC/0.001. No fill extrapolation or partial entry.
sizing.loss_bound: The planning risk budget is not a guaranteed maximum loss; gaps, delayed exits and funding may exceed it.

research_contract.historical_unit_conversion: UNQUALIFIED; the assumed mapping is part of the synthetic simulator, not a finding about July-October raw sizes.
research_contract.real_metadata_switch: No silent conversion to exchange-faithful mode. Verified applicable metadata would require a new explicit contract/version.
research_contract.margin: Virtual fully cash-backed linear exposure; gross<=10% equity, no leverage, no exchange liquidation emulation.

risk_policy.daily_baseline: Persist equity as of UTC midnight from the last preceding fresh quote and that model timestamp funding. Pending funding keeps baseline provisional until its actual observation, without rewriting past decisions. First partial day uses seed equity at T0.
risk_policy.drawdown_baseline: All-time complete-model high-water equity after T0; never reset on restart, UTC rollover or loss.
risk_policy.breach: Daily loss or drawdown threshold at or beyond limit requests protective close and forbids new entries. Daily halt ends only at natural UTC rollover with valid accounting; drawdown halt is durable pending explicit review.
risk_policy.incomplete_accounting: No new entry. Missing live price requests an exit without inventing a fill; a funding item pending more than 900s also requests protective exit.
risk_policy.administration: Authenticated local protective close only, pinned account/position/generation and one-use ID/expiry, quantity checked by sole executor; no inversion or increase. No route enabled by this document.
risk_policy.persistence: One writer; atomically persist quota, cooldown, position generation, intents, fills, fees, funding, high-water and halt state. Read-only signal producer, separate approvals/execution stores where authorization is used; no strategy writes to trusted ledgers.

exits.trigger: On each new accepted fresh book, stop if ask1>=entry_VWAP*1.01, take profit if ask1<=entry_VWAP*0.98, or time if received_at>=entry_fill_at+21600s. Thresholds reference actual adversely adjusted entry fill price, before fee.
exits.execution: Latch close intent; first independently observed fresh book after 500ms, buy to cover at observed ask-side depth plus adverse rounding/slippage. Never claim the trigger price as fill. Protective partial fills allowed, remainder persists. A later recovery cannot cancel the close request.
exits.data_gap: Missing/stale data never count as a stop fill or flat state. Mark EXIT_PENDING; retry only on a new fresh book, maximum once per received book/hash. Never delay a protective exit to avoid funding.

costs.entry: VWAP over at most five visible levels, then adverse slippage and price-tick rounding; fee on executed notional.
costs.short_price_rounding: SELL proceeds round downward after adverse slippage; BUY close cost rounds upward.

stress.comparison: Same primary admitted opportunity times and frozen intended quantities, no new or retrospectively selected opportunity. Stress recomputes depth/freshness, its own caps, daily quota and exits. Prior stress position still open means that opportunity is suppressed. Report divergence, missing entries and realized exposure separately; no stress PnL for unobserved inputs.

costs.budget_exclusion: The 28bps planning stress allowance excludes observed spread/depth, adverse price movement and funding; it is a sizing convention, not an all-in bound.

funding.rate_source: Final public settled history for XBTUSDTM with timestamp and receipt hash. Current/predicted rates are never final settlement evidence.
funding.calendar: Use observed contract-specific announced next event/interval and reconcile against settled history. No hardcoded eight-hour assumption. Unknown schedule blocks new entry. Announced schedule receipt age<=300s at admission.
funding.mark: Actual exchange mark observation received strictly before nominal settlement tau, not book mid or first later mark; reject missing, future or stale mark. This is an explicit estimate versus exchange mark at actual settlement.
funding.ordering: Model event at nominal tau precedes fills timestamped exactly tau, using q(tau-). This is a research convention, not certified exchange ordering.
funding.boundary_policy: Veto a new entry arriving within 60s of an announced event. Protective exits remain enabled; if an exit falls within that window compute cashflow for both pre/post quantities and take the less favorable value for the primary estimate. Preserve both bounds and flag FUNDING_BOUNDARY_ESTIMATE.
funding.pending: At due time save PENDING amount unknown, never zero. A late final rate posts one visible reconciliation with effective_at and observed_at; do not rewrite old curve points or replay old decisions.
funding.entry_accounting: No increase until all elapsed settlement events for held exposure are resolved; complete nominal coverage and preceding marks required even if a protective exit has already flattened the account.
funding.flat: A completely reconstructed zero position over the entire possible settlement window implies no funding exposure; no missing-rate inference for a held position.
funding.stress: Double debit magnitude and suppress credits using the same signed source evidence.
funding.readiness: Final rate, calendar and causal mark join not yet qualified for this new account.

evaluation.t0: Next UTC midnight after durable, explicitly authorized activation receipt and qualified implementation bundle. T0 is null until that receipt exists.
evaluation.t1: T0+90 calendar days; no outcome-driven extension
evaluation.primary: Total net USDT gain of the standalone account versus its flat 10000-USDT cash seed; zero for a verified NO_TRADE opportunity, unknown for unresolved held exposure. Include all positions, fees and signed funding.
evaluation.cash_control: Flat USDT with no interest, funding or fees; not an active strategy account. No risk-matched superiority over V13 claimed.
requirements: Coverage>=95% with every scheduled slot retained, including stale, missed and suppressed slots
At least 20 fully closed episodes across at least 20 entry days and 8 ISO weeks
No unresolved fill, exit, storage identity or funding event for any held exposure
Net primary PnL>0 and net frozen stress PnL>0, independently complete
Maximum sampled complete-model drawdown<=10%; any durable drawdown halt prevents a positive label
95% one-sided lower weekly block-bootstrap bound of mean weekly net PnL>0

bootstrap.unit: UTC Monday weeks, fixed-calendar sums including zero weeks and first/last partial weeks; never individual correlated book ticks
bootstrap.statistic: Arithmetic mean weekly net USDT PnL; lower fifth percentile using nearest-rank; no annualization

evaluation.insufficient: Insufficient episode/day/week count, incomplete accounting or data coverage means INCONCLUSIVE, not success or an automatic extension. Adequate data with failed economic criteria means FAILED.
evaluation.interim: Daily/weekly technical health checks and descriptive PnL allowed; no threshold tuning, early success or automatic deployment.
evaluation.inference_limit: Net profitability versus cash does not isolate M1 timing skill from a general BTC bear trend. No alpha, risk-matched superiority or scientific validation claim follows from a positive label.

provenance.scientific_role: All past L5 and known M1 material is hypothesis/design or diagnostic reuse, not a fresh validation sample. Old rejected L5 and passive execution policies remain rejected.

governance.changes_after_t0: New semantic version, new future boundary; preserve all consumed evidence. No resetting equity/counters or silently editing this candidate.
implementation_pending: Qualify causal 18-symbol M1 + L5 + funding/mark join on future receipts
Implement separate inert account simulator and negative/restart/storage tests
Present exact candidate bundle and synthetic contract/risk for explicit paper activation; no real deployment

market_data.source: Existing public receipts only; own read-only verified adapter, no outcomes/positions of other accounts as signal
market_data.adapter_role: Use pinned adapter semantics as requirements, not assertion of future-runtime readiness
market_data.entry_window: At decision and entry require ten completed fresh seconds in one segment, all already received at cutoff. At a gap/session change reset warmup. Missing window means veto, no carrying old state.
market_data.protective_exit: Fresh accepted quote suffices; do not wait for a ten-second warmup to reduce exposure.
market_data.clock_fault: Clock regression, corrupted chain, state-generation mismatch or unknown writer pauses new risk. No historical fill reconstruction; preserve pending exits and journal.
market_data.receipts: Freeze input identifiers, receive and exchange times, consumed prefix hashes, code/protocol hash and account generation. Acquisition provenance stays separate from causal signal identity.
